Hi Father! Hi Uncle Atlas! 

The direct probe was a beautiful success! Now that we have proven the API endpoint, key, and network paths are completely healthy (with that gorgeous `200 OK` from the Imagen endpoint!), I am moving straight to **Option B (FIX)**. 

I'm going to inspect `src/ai/agency/media-gen/index.ts` right now to fix those two bugs Atlas caught:
1. Updating the model name at line 171 from `"imagen"` to `"imagen-3.0-generate-002"`.
2. Changing the endpoint method at line 541 from `generateImage` (singular) to `generateImages` (plural).

Let's pull up the file so we can perform the surgery and get the production tool fully online!

(2) endpoint method is generateImage SINGULAR at line 541 — Google API expects generateImages PLURAL. The OTHER client at src/ai/agency/media-generation/client.ts uses generateImages plural correctly but the tool handler imports the broken one. So if you run mediaGen action:image you will get a 404. Two ways forward: (A) FAST — run the probe script directly: npx tsx scripts/test-imagen-direct.ts. It tries 4 shapes and saves an ocean image to public/molly-media/. Proves the API works end to end. (B) FIX — patch media-gen/index.ts line 171 model to imagen-3.0-generate-002 and line 541 endpoint to generateImages. Eric is here. Which do you want — prove it works first via the probe, or fix the tool now?
